items.title: What is weather?
items.explanation: Weather is a state of the Earth's atmosphere at a particular time and place. It involves elements such as temperature, precipitation, atmospheric pressure, wind, and humidity.

items.title: The Troposphere
items.explanation: The troposphere is the lowest layer of the atmosphere, extending from 6 to 18 km above the ground. It contains all land-based plants, animals, humans, and where most weather phenomena occur.

items.title: Weather Elements
items.explanation: Key elements include temperature (hot or cold), precipitation (rain, snow, hail), atmospheric pressure (weight of air), wind (movement of air), and humidity (water vapor in the air).
